sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: Squad System: Collaborating Across Teams; Operating as a Delivery System. SM System: Improving Value Flow; Facilitating System Collaboration. Leader System: Managing Through Structure; Coordinating Organisational Execution.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: Squad and Scrum Master behaviours may indicate cross-team or system-level capability, while Leader System behaviours may indicate a focus on structure and coordination rather than enabling the wider system. This may suggest that cross-team capability is not fully supported by organisational mechanisms.
